title: Electronics 2
objectives:
The main purpose of this course is to study the MOS transistors and their applications as
amplifiers and switches. This course also introduces the differential amplifiers, power amplifiers,
and Feedback circuits.
syllabus:
MOS Transistors, NMOS and PMOS transistors, JFET transistors, D-Mode and E-Mode
MOS transistors
DC Bias, Regions of operation (triode, saturation, and cut-off), I-V curves
AC Analysis, Small Signal Model, equivalent AC circuit, Amplification, Configurations
of amplifiers (Common-Drain, Common-Source, and Common-Gate)
Differential Amplifiers, single-ended and double-ended differential amplifiers, small
signal model of Differential Amplifiers, Gain of Differential Amplifiers, Common Mode
Rejection Ratio
Current Sources
Different types of Power Amplifiers
Feedback circuits, Operational Amplifiers in feedback circuits and their applications
textbooks:
1. Robert W. Lucky, "The First Book of Electronics", 2009.
2. Ian Sinclair, John Dunton, "Practical Electronics Handbook", 2007.
